label: late original-phase digit 3 in sequences starting with h or 2
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.004% of steps). Fires only in the original phase at late positions (t=6-9, mostly the last or second-to-last original token of L=8/9 sequences) and on the <DEL> step (16% of mass); never in the copy phase. 72% of mass is on input 3, and the sequence almost always starts with h or 2 (85% of mass). Activations are stronger when the prefix contains late-alphabet letters such as x, f, z, but adding that condition did not improve F1 by much. The predicate (input 3 at t>=6 in a sequence starting with h/2) gets ~59% of dev mass but only ~9% precision: most such steps stay silent, so the true trigger is a narrower conjunction over the prefix that was not identified. It does not fire on 3 early in the sequence, on copy-phase steps, or on sequences that start with other tokens.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=2 (+4.02), orig0=h (+3.96), prev_tok=x (+3.48), orig1=h (+2.65), phase=0 & in_tok=3 (+2.50), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=3 (+2.50). Lower it: phase=2 (-2.72), next_out=- (-2.41), orig8=- (-1.63), to_go=3 (-1.29).
